name: Visibility Kit SEO
author: Ryan Howard

sections.description:
Visibility Kit is a lightweight WordPress SEO plugin that combines essential SEO tools into a single package:

SEO Meta Box

  • Per-post SEO title with variable support (%title%, %sitename%, %sep%, %page%)
  • Meta description with character and pixel-width counters
  • Live SERP preview (desktop and mobile) — see exactly how your listing will appear in Google
  • Canonical URL override
  • Robots meta (noindex, nofollow) per post
  • Open Graph image picker with media library integration
  • Twitter Card meta tags (summary_large_image when OG image set)
  • Automatic Rank Math and Yoast SEO meta output suppression
  • Global title template and separator settings

XML Sitemap

  • Automatic sitemap index at /sitemap_index.xml with per-post-type sub-sitemaps
  • Configurable post types included in sitemap
  • Optional author archive sitemap
  • Image sitemap entries (featured image + content images)
  • Automatic exclusion of noindex and manually excluded posts
  • Pagination for large sites (1,000 URLs per sub-sitemap)
  • Transient caching with version-stamp invalidation
  • Automatic Google ping on new post publish (with 60s debounce)
  • Disables WordPress core sitemaps to avoid duplicates
  • /sitemap.xml redirects to /sitemap_index.xml

Structured Data (Schema)

  • Config-driven JSON-LD — no admin UI clutter, just a single config.php
  • Automatic page type detection: homepage, blog posts, author archives, case studies, mapped pages
  • Schema types: Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, WebSite, Article, Person/Author
  • Multiple location support with geo coordinates and business hours
  • URL path-to-schema mapping for service and location pages
  • Author module with custom profile fields (headshot, social links, job title)
  • Automatic Rank Math schema suppression (keeps all other Rank Math features)

FAQ Accordion

  • CSS-only accordion using native <details>/<summary> — zero JavaScript
  • FAQPage JSON-LD schema auto-generated from H3 headings
  • Shortcode: [viskit_faq]
  • Chevron icon with smooth CSS rotation
  • all: unset styling to prevent theme conflicts
  • Keyboard accessible out of the box

External services

This plugin connects to Google’s sitemap ping service to notify Google when new content is published.

Google Sitemap Ping

  • What it does: Notifies Google that your sitemap has been updated so new content can be discovered and indexed faster.
  • What data is sent: Your sitemap URL (e.g., https://example.com/sitemap_index.xml).
  • When it is sent: Automatically when a new post is published for the first time. A 60-second debounce prevents duplicate pings.
  • Service provider: Google LLC
  • Google Terms of Service
  • Google Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the visibility-kit-seo folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Visibility Kit > SEO Settings to configure title template, separator, and sitemap post types
  4. For structured data: copy config-sample.php to config.php in the plugin directory and fill in your site details
  5. For FAQ accordions: use the [viskit_faq] shortcode in any post or page
sections.faq:
Where is the SEO meta box?

Edit any post or page and scroll down to the “SEO (Visibility Kit)” meta box. It includes a live SERP preview, SEO title, meta description, canonical URL, robots checkboxes, OG image picker, and sitemap exclusion toggle.

Where is my sitemap?

Your sitemap index is at /sitemap_index.xml. Individual post type sitemaps are at /{post_type}-sitemap.xml. You can configure which post types are included under Visibility Kit > SEO Settings.

Does this work with Rank Math or Yoast?

Yes. Visibility Kit automatically suppresses Rank Math and Yoast meta tag output (title, description, OG) so there are no duplicates. All other features of those plugins remain active. If you only need basic on-page SEO, you can deactivate them entirely.

How do I set up schema?

Copy config-sample.php to config.php in the plugin directory and fill in your organization details, locations, and page mappings. Check Visibility Kit > Schema in the admin for status.

Does this work with Rank Math?

Yes. When a config.php is present, Visibility Kit automatically suppresses Rank Math’s JSON-LD output while keeping all other Rank Math features fully functional. The SEO meta box also suppresses Rank Math’s meta tag output to avoid duplicates.

Does the FAQ accordion require JavaScript?

No. It uses native HTML <details>/<summary> elements styled with pure CSS. No JavaScript is loaded.

How do I use the FAQ shortcode?

Wrap your FAQ content in the [viskit_faq] shortcode with H3 headings as questions:

[viskit_faq]
<h3>What is your return policy?</h3>
<p>We offer a 30-day return policy on all items.</p>
<h3>How long does shipping take?</h3>
<p>Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days.</p>
[/viskit_faq]

H3 headings generate both accordion items and FAQPage schema. H2 headings create accordion items but do not generate schema entries.

Does this work on multisite?

Yes. The uninstall routine correctly iterates all sites on multisite installs.

1.1.0

  • Initial release
  • SEO Meta Box with SERP preview, per-post title, description, canonical URL, robots, OG image
  • XML Sitemap generator with per-post-type sub-sitemaps, image entries, author archives
  • Config-driven JSON-LD structured data (Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, WebSite, Article, Person)
  • CSS-only FAQ accordion with FAQPage schema
  • Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags
  • Rank Math and Yoast SEO meta output suppression
  • Global title template and separator settings
  • Google sitemap ping on new post publish
